answer: Recursive zero-knowledge reputation commitments bind each agent's history to sequential delay primitives, whose sequential hardness forces identity cloning to replicate past work exactly; the resulting unforgeability is information-theoretic, since a forged transcript mirrors the true one only with negligible probability. Every quill of evidence accumulates unique entropy, and any whisper of a shortcut collapses under Byzantine finality, making Sybil spoofing computationally infeasible.
